verdict.rationale: Benchmark transparency is a fair question for a frontier model provider, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence that Anthropic's published benchmark claims include eval names, settings, harnesses or prompts. The system card item covers safety-testing risk areas, not benchmark methodology. The Artificial Analysis and SWE-bench listings are independent third-party leaderboards, not the product's own documented methodology.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, published benchmark claims come with enough methodology — eval names, settings, harness or prompts — that I could reproduce or at least audit them
